Description

Provide an In-Orbit Demonstration (IOD) and In-Orbit Verification (IOV) service in space, as part of a Horizon 2020 funded activity to strengthen the competitiveness of the EU space industry.

The European Commission has baselined a number of novel technology experiments for demonstration in low earth orbit. ISISpace is pleased to be selected by ESA to implement this activity by accommodating these experiments onboard two 6-Unit CubeSat platforms and to provide the experiment operations after launch.

Cubesat Carrier-2:

  • Spacepix-2 radiation detector – Evolving Systems Consulting
  • Melisa-III Low Frequency Noise Characterization Towards LISA – Universidad de Cádiz
  • Plasma Jet Pack - COMAT
